summary: On May 28, 2026, KKR FS Income Trust (the Company) entered into a Third Amendment to its Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent. The amendment increases the aggregate revolving commitments from $570 million to $750 million, with an accordion provision for up to $1,200 million, extends the commitment termination to May 28, 2030 and maturity to May 28, 2031, and adjusts applicable margins (ABR loans from 1.125% to 1.25% p.a.; term benchmark and RFR loans from 2.125% to 2.25% p.a.). This is a routine financing activity, not a special situation. No event-driven angle applies.
